policy: Intended surface changes since the recorded baseline. Each entry: match (prefix of a tools/compat.py difference line), reason, finding (review/plan id). Behavior-preserving PRs add nothing here.

exceptions.reason: Approval requests now bound preview destination to printable ASCII and expiry to 366 days; new deny code, existing codes unchanged.
Approval requests now bound preview destination to printable ASCII and expiry to 366 days; new deny code, existing codes unchanged.
SandboxProfile.workspace_bytes is validated to 1 MiB..16 GiB; new deny code.
A workspace already over its quota is refused before launch; the same reason names a receipt stopped by the quota watchdog.

Migration 0041 makes ix_memory_fts partial (search_document IS NOT NULL); restricted memory revisions carry no search document. Migration 0042 adds task_event (kind,goal_id,seq) and (task_id,kind,seq) indexes (plan 1.6 / ARCH-P1-4).

Correcting a suppressed memory item is refused; the owner must unsuppress explicitly.
A pinned memory item superseded by a newer item with the same conflict_key is surfaced as a conflict instead of being dropped.
An export may not contain near-duplicate inputs (normalized or 3-shingle Jaccard >= 0.8), which could straddle the development/holdout folds.
Adding, correcting or unsuppressing a pinned memory item is refused when the project's pins would not fit the default Ask; previously every Ask then failed with pinned_context_budget_exceeded.
A project holds at most 10 active pinned memory items (the default search page), checked when a pin is written.
New `panestria metrics ask-eval` grades recorded Ask attempts against a golden set; it runs no inference.
The ask-eval command uses the deterministic grader in verification.ask_eval.

New `panestria sandbox prepare-image` replaces the demo helper CI called to pull the pinned worker image (workers keep pull=never). It reports docker_unavailable, worker_image_timeout or worker_image_pull_failed.
